datasets.label: EuRoC · MH_01_easy
limitations: No recorded GNSS or magnetometer is present; GNSS observations are deterministic synthetic samples from reference truth.
Machine Hall orientation is an IMU-aided batch estimate rather than independent motion-capture orientation.
Reference-bias correction validates propagation/update math, not online bias observability.
Both tracks use the first reference attitude because the sequence begins in motion.

datasets.label: EuRoC · V1_03_difficult
limitations: No recorded GNSS or magnetometer is present; GNSS observations are deterministic synthetic samples from reference truth.
Raw vicon0 provides pose only; navigation velocity truth uses the EuRoC batch estimate.
The 40 ms pose time offset is a fixed dataset alignment parameter estimated against the published batch trajectory.
Reference-bias correction validates propagation/update math, not online bias observability.
Both tracks use the first reference attitude because the sequence begins in motion.

datasets.label: Blackbird · NYC Subway Winter
limitations: No recorded magnetometer, GNSS, or trusted-heading observation is present.
Synthetic GNSS is generated from motion-capture truth and is not receiver evidence.
The motion-capture sequence is independent attitude/position truth, but differentiated velocity is smoothed over 1.0 s.
The redistributed sequence is aggressive in angular rate and includes an IMU spike, but reaches about 3.03 m/s rather than the full corpus maximum.

datasets.label: UrbanNav · HK Medium Urban 1
datasets.role: recorded GNSS outage and SPAN reference
limitations: The platform is a ground vehicle, not an aircraft.
Receiver velocity/course is absent and is not synthesized; only recorded position is fused.
The SPAN-CPT reference is a separate high-grade post-processed GNSS/INS solution, not a laboratory motion-capture system.
The 131 s outage dominates overall trajectory RMSE, so nominal aided and outage metrics must be read separately.
The position-only track is statistically over-conservative in position NIS and over-confident in combined navigation NEES; noise modeling is not yet closed.
The published antenna lever-arm transform is not applied until its direction is independently resolved.

datasets.label: INSANE · outdoor_1_sensors
limitations: The direct heading observation and published pose share the dual-RTK baseline and are not independent sensor-versus-truth evidence.
The published full-pose tilt is inconsistent with the initial accelerometer gravity direction; only yaw-path evidence is accepted from this intake.
No declared heading faults are present, so fault rejection remains covered by synthetic and Vicon-derived stress tracks.
